minutes.headline: Committee tabled the FY24 capital plan and superintendent goals; approved its own goals and a sidewalk ARPA request.
minutes.summary: The committee heard a draft FY24 capital plan led by Turkey Hill and a turf and athletic complex study, then tabled it for two weeks. It also heard a records retention and storage briefing, approved its own goals, tabled the superintendent's goals, and approved an ARPA sidewalk application amended to stress safe access to Marshall Park.

what_happened.line: The School Committee tabled the FY24 capital plan, led by a large Turkey Hill investment, by a 5-0 vote; it returns October 5.
The committee tabled the superintendent's goals 5-0 after approving its own goals as presented.
Members approved an ARPA sidewalk application, amended to stress safe access to Marshall Park, and authorized the chair to finalize it.
The committee accepted the quarterly budget report 5-0; future reports will show the original budget and amendments.
The draft plan also included a study of a turf and athletic complex, and a member suggested a stabilization fund.

why_it_matters: The capital plan sets which building projects, such as Turkey Hill, go to the town's capital process, so its delay moves the date residents see the proposals before town forms are due.
The ARPA sidewalk request and the athletic complex study are routes by which school-related projects reach town funds, and the sidewalk cost was not known at the meeting.
